paired_run_interpretation.why_two_arms: balanced and wide span the irreducible density/coverage/token-mass tradeoff; balanced-only compact superiority would be ambiguous.
paired_run_interpretation.balanced_role: closest content-density and token-mass match to compact but higher source coverage, zero source-absent content, telegraphic surface.
paired_run_interpretation.wide_role: content/coverage-maximized source-only view with token mass close to compact but much higher content density and near-complete source coverage.
paired_run_interpretation.one_sided_positive_reading: if either source-only variant approaches compact and beats repeat on late stable selected families, source-word selection can reproduce much of the compact effect.
paired_run_interpretation.one_sided_negative_reading: if both source-only variants lag compact, the deficit is bundle-level evidence for natural generated compact re-expression plus fluency/source-absent/context distribution, not isolation of a single factor.
